verses.en: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
verses.pt: Mas um certo homem chamado Ananias, com Safira, sua mulher, vendeu uma propriedade,
verses.en_web: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira, his wife, sold a possession,
verses.en_bbe: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, got money for his property,

verses.en: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.pt: e reteve parte do preço, sabendo-o também sua mulher; e levando a outra parte, a depositou aos pés dos apóstolos.
verses.en_web: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.en_bbe: And kept back part of the price, his wife having knowledge of it, and took the rest and put it at the feet of the Apostles.

verses.en: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
verses.pt: Disse então Pedro: Ananias, por que encheu Satanás o teu coração, para que mentisses ao Espírito Santo e retivesses parte do preço do terreno?
verses.en_web: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
verses.en_bbe: But Peter said, Ananias, why has the Evil One put it into your heart to be false to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

verses.en: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
verses.pt: Enquanto o possuías, não era teu? e vendido, não estava o preço em teu poder? Como, pois, formaste este desígnio em teu coração? Não mentiste aos homens, mas a Deus.
verses.en_web: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”
verses.en_bbe: While you had it, was it not your property? and after you had given it in exchange, was it not still in your power? how has this purpose come into your mind? you have been false, not to men, but to God.

verses.en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
verses.pt: E Ananias, ouvindo estas palavras, caiu e expirou. E grande temor veio sobre todos os que souberam disto.
verses.en_web: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
verses.en_bbe: And at these words, Ananias went down on the earth, and his life went from him: and great fear came on all who were present.

verses.en: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
verses.pt: Levantando-se os moços, cobriram-no e, transportando-o para fora, o sepultaram.
verses.en_web: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
verses.en_bbe: And the young men went and made ready his body, and took it out, and put it in the earth.

verses.en: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
verses.pt: Depois de um intervalo de cerca de três horas, entrou também sua mulher, sabendo o que havia acontecido.
verses.en_web: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
verses.en_bbe: And about three hours after, his wife, having no knowledge of what had taken place, came in.

verses.en: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
verses.pt: E perguntou-lhe Pedro: Dize-me vendestes por tanto aquele terreno? E ela respondeu: Sim, por tanto.
verses.en_web: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”
verses.en_bbe: And Peter said to her, Give me an answer: was this amount of money the price of the land? And she said, Yes, it was.

verses.en: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
verses.pt: Então Pedro lhe disse: Por que é que combinastes entre vós provar o Espírito do Senhor? Eis aí à porta os pés dos que sepultaram o teu marido, e te levarão também a ti.
verses.en_web: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”
verses.en_bbe: But Peter said to her, Why have you made an agreement together to be false to the Spirit of the Lord? See, the feet of the young men who have put the body of your husband in the earth, are at the door, and they will take you out.

verses.en: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
verses.pt: Imediatamente ela caiu aos pés dele e expirou. E entrando os moços, acharam-na morta e, levando-a para fora, sepultaram-na ao lado do marido.
verses.en_web: She fell down immediately at his feet, and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away she went down at his feet, and her life went from her: and the young men came in and saw her dead, and they took her out and put her in the earth with her husband.

verses.en: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
verses.pt: Sobreveio grande temor a toda a igreja e a todos os que ouviram estas coisas.
verses.en_web: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
verses.en_bbe: Then great fear came on all the church and on all who had knowledge of these things.

verses.en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
verses.pt: E muitos sinais e prodígios eram feitos entre o povo pelas mãos dos apóstolos. E estavam todos de comum acordo no pórtico de Salomão.
verses.en_web: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
verses.en_bbe: Now a number of signs and wonders were done among the people by the hands of the Apostles; and they were all together in Solomon's covered way.

verses.en: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
verses.pt: Dos outros, porém, nenhum ousava ajuntar-se a eles; mas o povo os tinha em grande estima;
verses.en_web: None of the rest dared to join them, however the people honored them.
verses.en_bbe: The others, in fear, kept back from joining them: but the people made much of them;

verses.en: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
verses.pt: e cada vez mais se agregavam crentes ao Senhor em grande número tanto de homens como de mulheres;
verses.en_web: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
verses.en_bbe: And a great number of men and women had faith, and were joined to the Lord;

verses.en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
verses.pt: a ponto de transportarem os enfermos para as ruas, e os porem em leitos e macas, para que ao passar Pedro, ao menos sua sombra cobrisse alguns deles.
verses.en_web: They even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
verses.en_bbe: And they even took into the streets people who were ill, and put them on beds, so that when Peter went by, some of them might be in his shade.

verses.en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
verses.pt: Também das cidades circunvizinhas afluía muita gente a Jerusalém, conduzindo enfermos e atormentados de espíritos imundos, os quais eram todos curados.
verses.en_web: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people, and those who were tormented by unclean spirits: and they were all healed.
verses.en_bbe: And numbers of people came together from the towns round about Jerusalem, with those who were ill and those who were troubled with unclean spirits: and they were all made well.

verses.en: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
verses.pt: Levantando-se o sumo sacerdote e todos os que estavam com ele (isto é, a seita dos saduceus), encheram-se de inveja,
verses.en_web: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy,
verses.en_bbe: But the high priest and those who were with him (the Sadducees) were full of envy,

verses.en: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
verses.pt: deitaram mão nos apóstolos, e os puseram na prisão pública.
verses.en_web: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public custody.
verses.en_bbe: And they took the Apostles and put them in the common prison.

verses.en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
verses.pt: Mas de noite um anjo do Senhor abriu as portas do cárcere e, tirando-os para fora, disse:
verses.en_web: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out, and said,
verses.en_bbe: But in the night an angel of the Lord, opening the doors of the prison, took them out and said,

verses.en: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
verses.pt: Ide, apresentai-vos no templo, e falai ao povo todas as palavras desta vida.
verses.en_web: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”
verses.en_bbe: Go, take your place in the Temple and give the people all the teaching about this Life.

verses.en: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.pt: Ora, tendo eles ouvido isto, entraram de manhã cedo no templo e ensinavam. Chegando, porém o sumo sacerdote e os que estavam com ele, convocaram o sinédrio, com todos os anciãos dos filhos de Israel, e enviaram guardas ao cárcere para trazê-los.
verses.en_web: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and those who were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.en_bbe: And hearing this, they went into the Temple at dawn, and were teaching. But the high priest and those who were with him got together the Sanhedrin and the representatives of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to get them.

verses.en: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
verses.pt: Mas os guardas, tendo lá ido, não os acharam na prisão; e voltando, lho anunciaram,
verses.en_web: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
verses.en_bbe: But the men who were sent saw that they were not in the prison, and came back with the news,

verses.en: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
verses.pt: dizendo: Achamos realmente o cárcere fechado com toda a segurança, e as sentinelas em pé às portas; mas, abrindo-as, a ninguém achamos dentro.
verses.en_web: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, The doors of the prison were safely shut, and the keepers were at the doors, but when they were open, there was nobody inside.

verses.en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
verses.pt: E quando o capitão do templo e os principais sacerdotes ouviram estas palavras ficaram perplexos acerca deles e do que viria a ser isso.
verses.en_web: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
verses.en_bbe: Now, at these words, the captain of the Temple and the chief priests were greatly troubled about what might be the end of this business.

verses.en: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
verses.pt: Então chegou alguém e lhes anunciou: Eis que os homens que encerrastes na prisão estão no templo, em pé, a ensinar o povo.
verses.en_web: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
verses.en_bbe: And someone came and said to them, The men, whom you put in prison, are in the Temple teaching the people.

verses.en: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
verses.pt: Nisso foi o capitão com os guardas e os trouxe, não com violência, porque temiam ser apedrejados pelo povo.
verses.en_web: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
verses.en_bbe: Then the captain and some of the police went and took them, but not violently, for fear that they might be stoned by the people.

verses.en: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
verses.pt: E tendo-os trazido, os apresentaram ao sinédrio. E o sumo sacerdote os interrogou, dizendo:
verses.en_web: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
verses.en_bbe: And they took them into the Sanhedrin, and the high priest said to them,

verses.en: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
verses.pt: Não vos admoestamos expressamente que não ensinásseis nesse nome? e eis que enchestes Jerusalém dessa vossa doutrina e quereis lançar sobre nós o sangue desse homem.
verses.en_web: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
verses.en_bbe: We gave you very clear orders not to give teaching in this name: and now Jerusalem is full of your teaching, and you are attempting to make us responsible for this man's death.

verses.en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
verses.pt: Respondendo Pedro e os apóstolos, disseram: Importa antes obedecer a Deus que aos homens.
verses.en_web: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
verses.en_bbe: But Peter and the Apostles, answering, said, We have to do the orders of God, not of man.

verses.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
verses.pt: O Deus de nossos pais ressuscitou a Jesus, ao qual vós matastes, suspendendo-o no madeiro;
verses.en_web: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
verses.en_bbe: The God of our fathers gave Jesus back to life, whom you had put to death, hanging him on a tree.

verses.en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
verses.pt: sim, Deus, com a sua destra, o elevou a Príncipe e Salvador, para dar a Israel o arrependimento e remissão de pecados.
verses.en_web: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
verses.en_bbe: Him God has put on high at his right hand, as a Ruler and a Saviour, to give to Israel a change of heart and forgiveness of sins.

verses.en: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
verses.pt: E nós somos testemunhas destas coisas, e bem assim o Espírito Santo, que Deus deu àqueles que lhe obedecem.
verses.en_web: We are His witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
verses.en_bbe: And we are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who keep his laws.

verses.en: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
verses.pt: Ora, ouvindo eles isto, se enfureceram e queriam matá-los.
verses.en_web: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
verses.en_bbe: But when these words came to their ears, they were cut to the heart, and had a mind to put them to death.

verses.en: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
verses.pt: Mas, levantando-se no sinédrio certo fariseu chamado Gamaliel, doutor da lei, acatado por todo o povo, mandou que por um pouco saíssem aqueles homens;
verses.en_web: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
verses.en_bbe: But one of the Sanhedrin, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a man of learning in the law, of whom all the people had a high opinion, got up and made a suggestion for the men to be put outside for a little time.

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
verses.pt: e prosseguiu: Varões israelitas, acautelai-vos a respeito do que estai para fazer a estes homens.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Men of Israel, take care what you do about these men.

verses.en: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
verses.pt: Porque, há algum tempo, levantou-se Teudas, dizendo ser alguém; ao qual se ajuntaram uns quatrocentos homens; mas ele foi morto, e todos quantos lhe obedeciam foram dispersos e reduzidos a nada.
verses.en_web: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nothing.
verses.en_bbe: For before this there was Theudas, who said he was someone important, to whom about four hundred men gave their support: he was put to death, and his band was broken up and came to nothing.

verses.en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
verses.pt: Depois dele levantou-se Judas, o galileu, nos dias do recenseamento, e levou muitos após si; mas também este pereceu, e todos quantos lhe obedeciam foram dispersos.
verses.en_web: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
verses.en_bbe: After this man, there was Judas of Galilee, at the time of the numbering, and some of the people went after him: he was put to death, and all his supporters were put to flight.

verses.en: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
verses.pt: Agora vos digo: Dai de mão a estes homens, e deixai-os, porque este conselho ou esta obra, caso seja dos homens, se desfará;
verses.en_web: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
verses.en_bbe: And now I say to you, Do nothing to these men, but let them be: for if this teaching or this work is of men, it will come to nothing:

verses.en: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
verses.pt: mas, se é de Deus, não podereis derrotá-los; para que não sejais, porventura, achados até combatendo contra Deus.
verses.en_web: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
verses.en_bbe: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overcome them, and you are in danger of fighting against God.

verses.en: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.pt: Concordaram, pois, com ele, e tendo chamado os apóstolos, açoitaram-nos e mandaram que não falassem em nome de Jesus, e os soltaram.
verses.en_web: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.en_bbe: And he seemed to them to be right: and they sent for the Apostles, and, after having them whipped and giving them orders to give no teaching in the name of Jesus, they let them go.

verses.en: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
verses.pt: Retiraram-se pois da presença do sinédrio, regozijando-se de terem sido julgados dignos de sofrer afronta pelo nome de Jesus.
verses.en_web: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
verses.en_bbe: So they went away from the Sanhedrin, happy to undergo shame for the Name.

verses.en: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: E todos os dias, no templo e de casa em casa, não cessavam de ensinar, e de anunciar a Jesus, o Cristo.
verses.en_web: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And every day, in the Temple and privately, they went on teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ.
